introHtml: Gbond mugs bring a rugged, outdoor-inspired aesthetic to your promotional lineup. Their speckled finishes and campfire motifs make them a natural fit for brands in the camping, outdoor gear, or adventure travel space. Whether you are outfitting a company retreat or creating a giveaway for a trade show, these mugs hold up to daily use and can be decorated with your logo using screen printing or full-color transfer. The classic C handle provides a comfortable grip, even when filled with hot coffee or tea.
